evidence.object: Fabricación, grabación y suministro de un juego de bolas de premios para el Sorteo Extraordinario de Navidad
evidence.contractingBody: Comisión de Contratación de la Sociedad Estatal Loterías y Apuestas del Estado, S.M.E., S.A.

interpretation.materialFinding: The 2026 Christmas draw has a separately procured new prize-ball set in addition to the previously documented complete numbered-ball replacement contract 25/042.
interpretation.mechanicalEraUse: Treat 2026-12-22 as a predeclared new-ball mechanical era for both number balls and prize balls. Do not infer any directional bias from procurement alone.
missingForBiasTest: evidence linking any measured deviation to extraction probability
